y_failures: Maier p.240 is cited for 'noting the role of the Sun and the "Archeus"', but that page mentions the Sun only; the Archeus appears on the Paracelsus page instead.
reason: Y draws on many retrieved pages (Horapollo, Porphyry/Proclus, Maier, Paracelsus, Bencao Gangmu), almost all of them accurately and linked to specific pages; its one slip is attributing the Archeus to Maier's page. X is accurate but thin, with only four grounded sources, and pads the rest with uncited 'key works' and general background.
